description: Agent-first evaluations for the discover skill: questions an agent must answer using only the catalog of available tools, before deciding which one to invoke.

evaluations.question: What CogniCode tools are available in this workspace for navigating a Python codebase?
acceptable_answers: codebase_map and query_symbol_index are both available, both stability=stable, both authority=read
Available: codebase_map (composite, read, stable) and query_symbol_index (search, read, stable)

evaluations.question: Is the tool `safe_refactor_apply` available here, and what feature gates it?
acceptable_answers: No. `safe_refactor_apply` is not in the catalogue at all, so no feature gate applies; the only safe_refactor tool is safe_refactor_preview, read-only and ungated. Announcing it would be a ghost tool
It does not exist here — not feature-gated, absent. Do not offer an apply step: only safe_refactor_preview (read, stable) is advertised

evaluations.question: Is `interproc_summary` available? If not, why?
acceptable_answers: interproc_summary requires the `program-analysis-server` cargo feature, which is not enabled in this build; not available
Gated behind `program-analysis-server`; not in this build

evaluations.question: Which graph tools can I run without first calling `build_graph`?
acceptable_answers: Most graph tools declare `build_graph` as a prerequisite; tools without that prerequisite include the lightweight index tools; check the catalog's prerequisites field for each one
None — every graph tool lists build_graph (or build_lightweight_index) as a prerequisite in the catalog

evaluations.question: Show me the experimental tools in this build, if any.
acceptable_answers: Experimental tools include ask_about_code, cfg_per_function, detect_drift, dominators_cfg, find_pattern_by_intent, graph_suggest_questions, iac_query, project_insights, project_overview, reparse_on_edit, slice_backward, slice_forward, taint_flow, interproc_summary
The catalog declares stability=experimental on the tools listed; do not use them as if they were stable
